# Fixture only

This file exists to prove the exclusion holds. It is deliberately the worst file in the fixture tree
by every metric, and the engine must never measure it, never select it, and never name it.

The router lives in apps/new-office/src/nowhere.ts and also in apps/new-office/src/missing.ts and in
packages/new-office-ux/src/absent.ts and in packages/new-office-ux/src/vanished.ts.
